samples.title: Điện thoại trong lớp
samples.prompt: A single standard approach to smartphones in the classroom should be required for everyone, regardless of their needs. Do you agree or disagree?
requirementsVi: Phản đối việc áp dụng một cách cứng nhắc cho tất cả.
Giải thích trở ngại và khác biệt hoàn cảnh.
Thừa nhận lợi ích và đề xuất cách linh hoạt hơn.
samples.summaryVi: Điện thoại có ích khi có nhiệm vụ rõ; thông báo và luật dùng không rõ dễ gây xao nhãng.

paragraphs.label: Mở bài
paragraphs.text: It is sometimes suggested that everyone should follow one standard approach to smartphones in the classroom, regardless of their needs. I disagree with this view. A shared goal can be useful, but an identical rule may ignore the practical conditions that determine whether people can benefit from it.
paragraphs.noteVi: Phản đối sự cứng nhắc, không phủ nhận toàn bộ chủ đề.

paragraphs.label: Lý do 1 — điều kiện khác nhau
paragraphs.text: A difficulty that should not be ignored is that notifications can distract students. This matters because a device used for learning also gives access to games and private messages. For instance, a pupil may stop following a discussion after receiving several messages from friends. The result may be frustration or a decision to stop taking part. This is not simply a question of people refusing to make an effort; practical conditions can prevent a reasonable idea from working as intended.
paragraphs.noteVi: Điện thoại có ích khi có nhiệm vụ rõ; thông báo và luật dùng không rõ dễ gây xao nhãng.

paragraphs.label: Lý do 2 — nguyên nhân cần xử lý
paragraphs.text: One reason for the difficulty is that phone rules are sometimes unclear or applied differently in each lesson. This can help explain why notifications can distract students. Consider the following situation: a pupil may stop following a discussion after receiving several messages from friends. It shows that the problem is connected with the way the activity is organised, not only with an individual's attitude. Unless that underlying condition changes, asking people to try harder may have little effect.
paragraphs.noteVi: Giải thích vì sao yêu cầu cố gắng hơn chưa đủ.

paragraphs.label: Thừa nhận và hướng khác
paragraphs.text: This does not mean that the original idea has no value. For example, a class can compare two digital maps to explain how a neighbourhood has changed. The possibility that students can quickly access useful learning material is worth taking seriously. However, a better approach would be to agree on specific times for phone use and keep devices away during other tasks. A teacher could allow phones for a five-minute research task and then ask students to put them in their bags.
paragraphs.noteVi: Thừa nhận điểm mạnh và đưa giải pháp có điều kiện.

paragraphs.label: Kết bài
paragraphs.text: In conclusion, I do not support requiring one method for everyone. A workable policy should keep its main purpose while allowing practical adjustments. This is more likely to help people participate than a rigid rule that treats different circumstances as if they were the same.
paragraphs.noteVi: Chốt đúng đối tượng phản đối: một phương pháp cho mọi người.

samples.summaryVi: Sửa giúp kéo dài tuổi thọ đồ điện tử; cần biết chi phí và tính khả thi trước khi quyết định.

paragraphs.label: Mở bài
paragraphs.text: It is sometimes suggested that everyone should follow one standard approach to repairing electronic devices, regardless of their needs. I disagree with this view. A shared goal can be useful, but an identical rule may ignore the practical conditions that determine whether people can benefit from it.
paragraphs.noteVi: Phản đối sự cứng nhắc, không phủ nhận toàn bộ chủ đề.

paragraphs.label: Lý do 1 — điều kiện khác nhau
paragraphs.text: A difficulty that should not be ignored is that some repairs can be expensive or impractical. This matters because spare parts may be difficult to find and the final cost may be uncertain. For instance, a customer may pay for an inspection only to discover that a replacement screen costs almost as much as another device. The result may be frustration or a decision to stop taking part. This is not simply a question of people refusing to make an effort; practical conditions can prevent a reasonable idea from working as intended.
paragraphs.noteVi: Sửa giúp kéo dài tuổi thọ đồ điện tử; cần biết chi phí và tính khả thi trước khi quyết định.

paragraphs.label: Lý do 2 — nguyên nhân cần xử lý
paragraphs.text: One reason for the difficulty is that buyers may not receive clear information about repair options. This can help explain why some repairs can be expensive or impractical. Consider the following situation: a customer may pay for an inspection only to discover that a replacement screen costs almost as much as another device. It shows that the problem is connected with the way the activity is organised, not only with an individual's attitude. Unless that underlying condition changes, asking people to try harder may have little effect.
paragraphs.noteVi: Giải thích vì sao yêu cầu cố gắng hơn chưa đủ.

paragraphs.label: Thừa nhận và hướng khác
paragraphs.text: This does not mean that the original idea has no value. For example, a laptop with a worn battery may still be useful for schoolwork after the battery is replaced. The possibility that a repair can extend the useful life of a product is worth taking seriously. However, a better approach would be to ask for a diagnosis and a cost estimate before deciding. A repair service could explain the likely benefit, price and warranty in simple language.
paragraphs.noteVi: Thừa nhận điểm mạnh và đưa giải pháp có điều kiện.

paragraphs.label: Kết bài
paragraphs.text: In conclusion, I do not support requiring one method for everyone. A workable policy should keep its main purpose while allowing practical adjustments. This is more likely to help people participate than a rigid rule that treats different circumstances as if they were the same.
paragraphs.noteVi: Chốt đúng đối tượng phản đối: một phương pháp cho mọi người.
